Something outside the brief?

One-off projects, additional deliverables, or a different scope. Let’s put together a tailored quote.

Let’s talk
Service terms & what to expect +
  • All services are delivered digitally. No physical printing, production, filming, or shipping is included unless separately agreed.
  • Project timelines begin after payment and receipt of all required content, access, and brand materials.
  • A revision round means one consolidated set of feedback from the client. Changes outside the approved brief may be billed separately.
  • Any work beyond the listed package scope will be quoted and approved before it begins.
  • For monthly services, payment is due at the start of each billing cycle. Unused monthly deliverables do not roll over unless agreed in writing.
  • Video editing clients must provide organized raw footage, scripts, and required brand assets. The video packages assume a maximum of 5 minutes of supplied raw footage per short-form video.
  • Video packages exclude filming, scripting, voiceover recording, content strategy, complex VFX, and advanced compositing unless separately quoted.
  • SEO packages exclude paid advertising, paid backlinks, premium third-party tool subscriptions, extensive website development, and guaranteed rankings. SEO outcomes depend on competition, website condition, and implementation.

06 FAQ

Questions before
you outsource?

Can’t find your answer? Email info@ditsa.com.np and we’ll reply.

Where is your team based?+

We’re in Kathmandu, Nepal (GMT+5:45) and work remotely with brands, agencies, and creators around the world. Everything is delivered digitally.

How does payment work?+

All prices are in USD. Monthly services are paid at the start of each billing cycle, and project work is paid before it begins. Unused monthly deliverables don’t roll over unless agreed in writing.

When does my project start?+

Timelines begin once payment is received and we have all the content, access, and brand materials needed for the work.

How do revisions work?+

Each plan includes a set number of revision rounds. A round is one consolidated set of feedback from you. Changes outside the approved brief are quoted separately.

Do you film or record video?+

No. Video plans cover editing. You supply organised raw footage, scripts, and brand assets. Filming, scripting, voiceover recording, and complex VFX can be quoted separately.

Do you guarantee SEO rankings?+

No honest SEO provider can. Results depend on competition, your website’s condition, and implementation. Our plans exclude paid ads and paid backlinks.
